meta.title: Review previous bid revisions of a vendor

steps.note: Open the prepared published RFQ with a vendor bid revision.
Navigate to the buyer's Responses view where the current bid and revision controls are shown.

args.goal: on the buyer's Responses screen, hover the vendor's Current bid value, select an earlier bid version, verify the displayed bid value changes to that revision, use the adjacent arrow controls to cycle through the available revisions and return to the current bid, and stop with the current bid displayed

steps.note: Perform and verify the revision selection and cycling behavior that no catalog step exposes by label.
Confirm the revision interaction completed without an application error.
